text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'A threshold-weighted score of the whole forecast range, counting only what happens above the 99th or 95th percentile of the series' history (farm output peaks and demand peaks) or below its 5th percentile (demand lows, which drive reverse flow). 292 daily forecast runs from July 2025 to June 2026, each forecasting up to 14 days ahead. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months.'
text.tspan: A threshold-weighted score of the whole forecast range, counting only what happens above the 99th or 95th
percentile of the series' history (farm output peaks and demand peaks) or below its 5th percentile (demand
lows, which drive reverse flow). 292 daily forecast runs from July 2025 to June 2026, each forecasting up to
14 days ahead. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months.
